capabilities: Chat with vault notes using hybrid semantic and keyword search with inline citations
Run an agent that reads, writes, and edits vault files and delegates to sub-agents
Generate quizzes, flashcards, concept maps, and narrated slideshows from notes
Manage RSS feeds and import feed items as chat context
Execute JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and Dataview code blocks from chat responses
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires API keys for cloud providers; local models via LM Studio or Ollama need no key. Indexing happens locally, but note content is sent to providers the user configures.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI features, so chatting with notes, generating study material, or running local/cloud LLMs requires leaving the app or juggling separate tools.

relations.evidence: Execute Dataview and DataviewJS blocks inline.
LM Studio is detected as a native provider — no API key required.
leverage AI to create new Excalidraw diagrams or Canvas files

requires.name: Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, OpenCode, Nvidia, Mistral, Cohere, or other provider
LM Studio or Ollama for local models

summary: AI assistant plugin that adds vault chat, an agent, study-material generation, concept maps, slideshows, RSS feeds, and code execution inside Obsidian.
